profile.name: Cytomat自动微孔板培养箱
profile.description: Cytomat自动微孔板培养箱是一种带内部机械传板机构的板式存储与培养设备，可在受控温度、二氧化碳、氧气和湿度条件下存放并培养微孔板。它常用于细胞培养、活性检测和高通量筛选流程中，在存储位、等待位、传递口和设备外部位置之间自动转运板件，并可支持摇动培养和条码读取。
profile.description_en: The Cytomat automated microplate incubator is a plate storage and incubation unit with an internal robotic transport mechanism. It stores and incubates microplates under controlled temperature, CO2, O2, and humidity conditions. It is commonly used in cell culture, assay workflows, and high-throughput screening to automatically move plates between storage sites, wait positions, transfer stations, and external access positions, with support for shaking incubation and barcode reading.
